svg.title: Small-Parcel GSR Refund Recovery Workflow
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-gsr-refund-recovery-workflow; chapter number: 1; title: Small-Parcel GSR Refund Recovery Workflow; subtitle: From billing credentials to phone-escalated late-package refunds; chart type: process_flow; stages: step: 01; label: Billing Credential Handoff; value: Step 1; detail: Take the shipper's online billing credentials; Refund Retriever compares its constant invoice and shipping monitoring to mint.com.; step: 02; label: Invoice Auto-Download; value: Step 2; detail: Auto-download every FedEx and UPS invoice so no late package slips past, since the carriers never flag the refund themselves.; step: 03; label: 40-44 Point Shipment Audit; value: Step 3; detail: Audit 40 to 44 points per shipment and flag any package delivered even 60 seconds late; scan the original reason column for 'systematic SVC fail' credits FedEx already refunded automatically.; step: 04; label: GSR Dispute Filing; value: Step 4; detail: File inside the 15-day window and hold FedEx invoice payment until disputes are in, because an existing payment on file triggered automatic denial of every late-package claim.; step: 05; label: Denial Escalation Loop; value: Step 5; detail: Resubmit denied claims and escalate to live phone agents; Refund Retriever's agents reversed all 5 FedEx auto-denials, recovering $98.42 on a $4,253.53 invoice (2.3%).; caption: FedEx and UPS guarantee time-definite delivery, and practitioners from Refund Retriever, Empact Parcel, and Compete Consulting Group run the same credential-to-escalation loop on contingency, from Cerasis's 30 percent model to Refund Retriever's 50 percent starting split.; assumptions note: Fee terms vary by firm: Refund Retriever starts at 50% of savings and negotiates down for higher-volume shippers, while Cerasis shows a $700 net refund on $1,000 of savings at 30%. Step order follows the reported workflow; the only reported clock is the 15-day late-package claim window.; note: Attributed to Refund Retriever (P3sA9eO0D-k, JeLyjRF9HEk, 8Bw_30ivpb4, vOX4irOA_Tk), Scarbrough Global (NKDaSW7CKiQ), Share a Refund (eTB0fyueR5A, PheSsrwvW9c), and Cerasis, now part of GlobalTranz (GnXmnbxCZ-A).

circle.title: step: 01; label: Billing Credential Handoff; value: Step 1; detail: Take the shipper's online billing credentials; Refund Retriever compares its constant invoice and shipping monitoring to mint.com.

text.title: Take the shipper's online billing credentials; Refund Retriever compares its constant invoice and shipping monitoring to mint.com.

circle.title: step: 02; label: Invoice Auto-Download; value: Step 2; detail: Auto-download every FedEx and UPS invoice so no late package slips past, since the carriers never flag the refund themselves.

text.title: Auto-download every FedEx and UPS invoice so no late package slips past, since the carriers never flag the refund themselves.

circle.title: step: 03; label: 40-44 Point Shipment Audit; value: Step 3; detail: Audit 40 to 44 points per shipment and flag any package delivered even 60 seconds late; scan the original reason column for 'systematic SVC fail' credits FedEx already refunded automatically.

text.title: Audit 40 to 44 points per shipment and flag any package delivered even 60 seconds late; scan the original reason column for 'systematic SVC fail' credits FedEx already refunded automatically.

circle.title: step: 04; label: GSR Dispute Filing; value: Step 4; detail: File inside the 15-day window and hold FedEx invoice payment until disputes are in, because an existing payment on file triggered automatic denial of every late-package claim.

text.title: File inside the 15-day window and hold FedEx invoice payment until disputes are in, because an existing payment on file triggered automatic denial of every late-package claim.

circle.title: step: 05; label: Denial Escalation Loop; value: Step 5; detail: Resubmit denied claims and escalate to live phone agents; Refund Retriever's agents reversed all 5 FedEx auto-denials, recovering $98.42 on a $4,253.53 invoice (2.3%).

text.title: Resubmit denied claims and escalate to live phone agents; Refund Retriever's agents reversed all 5 FedEx auto-denials, recovering $98.42 on a $4,253.53 invoice (2.3%).

Assumptions: Fee terms vary by firm: Refund Retriever starts at 50% of savings and negotiates down for higher-volume shippers, while Cerasis shows a $700 net refund on $1,000 of savings at 30%. Step order follows the reported workflow; the only reported clock is the 15-day late-package claim window.
